fields.reason: The paper explicitly compares a retrieve-then-read model (R) with a vanilla LLM baseline (B) that answers without retrieval, using the same generator weights.

selector.exact: We include the vanilla LLM, which is prompted with the question and nothing else; we denote it by B. We include the retrieve-then-read model, which looks up supporting documents for each question and reads them before it answers; we denote it by R.
